title: Kestrel GAP Waiver Addendum: Exclusions and Limitations
content:
# Kestrel GAP Waiver Addendum — Exclusions and Limitations

**Exclusions.** Under the Kestrel GAP Waiver addendum:

(a) Losses on vehicles in commercial use are excluded.

(b) The following are subtracted from the payoff before the benefit is computed:
  - insurer deductions for unrepaired prior damage;
  - salvage the owner kept;
  - past-due installments;
  - late and returned-payment fees;
  - refunds due from cancelled add-on products.

(c) Any benefit above the remaining balance is never paid to the borrower.

(d) The waiver cannot be transferred.

## Clause by clause

| Clause | Effect on a claim or on the waiver |
|---|---|
| Commercial use | A loss on a vehicle in commercial use is excluded |
| Prior damage | An insurer deduction for unrepaired prior damage reduces the payoff used for the benefit |
| Retained salvage | Salvage kept by the owner reduces the payoff used for the benefit |
| Past-due installments | Reduce the payoff used for the benefit |
| Late and returned-payment fees | Reduce the payoff used for the benefit |
| Refunds due from cancelled add-on products | Reduce the payoff used for the benefit |
| Surplus | No part of a benefit above the remaining balance goes to the borrower |
| Transfer | The waiver cannot be transferred |

## Illustration (hypothetical figures)

A payoff of 21000.00 that includes 650.00 of past-due installments and 45.00 of late fees, where the insurer also deducted 400.00 for unrepaired prior damage, is taken as 19905.00 before the benefit is computed: 21000.00 less 650.00, less 45.00, less 400.00.
